material.acceptance_criteria: On a green CI tip, the 'sim as wasip3 guest on nightly' job loads a test mod in the wasip3 guest and prints a mod-load success line (not the refusal), and the native host check still passes.
material.blocked_by: wasip3-mod-runtime-blocker-gm-orch-7-wasip3-mod (no wasm32-wasip3 std locally; lua-src has no wasi arm and CI has no wasi C sysroot or setjmp path; see .gm/receipts/wasip3-mod-runtime/01-orient.md)
material.description: User direction: wasip3 is the target. The wasip3 guest currently refuses mod-load (rust/crates/wasip3/src/lib.rs:65) because vendored lua-src has no wasi build arm. Make mod-host build and load a mod inside the wasip3 guest, so the CI guest runs a mod on the map image, not only the sim.
material.subject: The wasip3 guest carries the mod runtime (mod-load works on wasm32-wasip3)
material.witness: CI run 39101571236 at head 9a29aa8, job 'sim as wasip3 guest on nightly' success: 'wasip3 mod-load ok mod=wasip3-test' passed the grep gate; no refusal line.
material.witness_plan: CI log of the sim-as-wasip3-guest job shows the mod-load success line on a complete green run; verifier witness on that tip.
